lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Hi Priya, it's Jordan from Copperleaf Home Loans. You were looking at condos over on the east side, right?
Yeah, hey Jordan. Yeah, we put in an offer on one actually, we're waiting to hear back.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Oh exciting! How many offers have you put in so far?
Sure, it's dana.sample@example.com, and I was born 04/12/1991 if you need that.
This is the third. The first two went way over asking. It's been kind of brutal.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: That market is no joke. So where are you at on the financing side?
Well, I got a payment estimate from the online calculator and it's just way more than I want to pay every month. Like, I don't know how anyone affords this.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: I hear that a lot. A lot of that calculator stuff uses generic assumptions, taxes, insurance, HOA. Did you put your actual HOA in?
No, I think I just used the defaults.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Okay, so that number could be off in either direction. That's worth checking with real numbers.
Also, to be honest, my credit union already pre-approved me. I'll probably just go with them since I've banked there forever.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Look, credit unions are fine for checking accounts, but they're slow and they're going to bury you in fees. You'll lose this condo waiting on them.
Hm. I mean, they've been pretty good to me so far.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Fair enough. What I'd really like to do is just be a second look. Do you have their loan estimate yet?
I have the pre-approval letter, not like a full estimate.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Got it. Once your offer's accepted you'll get a formal loan estimate from them. If you want, send me the details and I can show you what ours looks like side by side.
Maybe. How long does it usually take you guys to close?

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Typically we can close within the contract window, usually around thirty days, depending on the appraisal and how fast we get documents.
Okay. Let me see if the offer even gets accepted first.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Totally makes sense. Can I check back in with you Thursday afternoon or Friday morning?
Friday's fine.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Great, talk to you Friday, fingers crossed on the offer.
Thanks, bye.
